# Businessverse Academic Week
UTCC Business School — คณะบริหารธุรกิจ มหาวิทยาลัยหอการค้าไทย

An educational business simulation covering eight disciplines and 24 sequential decisions. Participants receive one persistent strategic objective, complete three decisions per discipline, and earn passport stamps. Organizers open each discipline's first question. Rankings are organizer-only.

## Disciplines
- Management: strategy and resource allocation
- Marketing: STP and value propositions
- E-Sport: community participation and brand fit
- Digital Marketing: funnels, attribution and channel budgets
- Logistics: total cost, service and supply chain resilience
- International Business: market entry and country risk
- Digital & Innovation: technology capabilities and cybersecurity
- Finance: cash flow, investment and liquidity

## Strategic objectives
Growth Company: Sales > 145.
Premium Brand: Brand > 120 and Risk < 55.
Cost Leader: Cash > 200,000 and Operations > 100.
Customer Champion: Customer > 130.

No event date or venue has been confirmed in this application.

## Rules
Players begin with 1,200,000 Business Coins; Sales, Customer, Brand and Operations are each 50; Risk is 5. Each discipline contains a knowledge check, strategic decision and crisis response. Some decisions permit multiple investments subject to a budget and available cash. Decisions cannot be changed after submission. The next question opens automatically after submission; departments follow a fixed sequence to preserve simulation state. Answers, costs, resource effects and target-fit scoring are validated on the server.

## Scoring
The qualifying total has 40 points for business simulation, 10 points for the assigned strategic target achieved after all 24 decisions, and 30 points for decision quality. Decision-fit scores and rankings are not shown to participants. The top 10 teams advance to a 20-point Final Business Crisis. Organizers have a live scoreboard highlighting the top 10 teams and a fullscreen presentation with explicit unlock confirmation.

## Assignment
The four target definitions originate from the reference application. Team numbers cycle Growth, Premium, Cost and Customer. Targets are persisted on account creation. Only organizers may change an assignment, and only before the player's first answer. No target-fit answer keys are returned to participant browsers.

## Navigation
/ — public challenge hub
/guide — public event guide
/departments/:slug — public discipline overview
/join — team sign-in with organizer-issued code; excluded from search
/passport — authenticated player's own completion and business state; excluded from search
/play/:slug — authenticated challenge; excluded from search
/admin — authorized organizer dashboard; excluded from search
